claim_scope: Constitutive-form robustness attestation for the filler-reinforcement law underlying the Guth-Gold scratch-hardness baseline on Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer only, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Intervals are marginal not conditional. Phase-1 would require independent wet-lab validation and a cross-formulator dataset.
honest_interpretation: Three canonical rigid-filler reinforcement laws were fitted on the identical Purformance HTE 2K-PUR dataset (n=86), identical leave-one-iteration-out split, and identical Efron-Tibshirani paired bootstrap as the parent Guth-Gold receipt, isolating the constitutive functional form as the ONLY variable. Pooled LOIO R2: Guth-Gold (1938) 0.3345; Mooney (1951) 0.3436; Halpin-Tsai rigid-limit (1969) 0.3503. Mooney and Halpin-Tsai each carry one EXTRA free shape parameter (crowding factor S; aspect zeta) and are therefore strictly more flexible than the fixed-coefficient Guth-Gold law. The paired Delta-R2 bootstrap CI for Mooney-minus-Guth-Gold INCLUDES zero and for Halpin-Tsai-minus-Guth-Gold INCLUDES zero. Neither alternative law significantly changes the fit. Because the more flexible laws do not beat Guth-Gold, the reinforcement signal is robust to the specific particulate constitutive form -- consistent with the classical result that these laws agree to leading order in phi and diverge only at high filler loading, which this low-phi coating regime does not reach. The hostile-null y-shuffle collapses the best alternative's R2 to -0.0962 (<0.10), confirming the fit is not exchangeability leakage.
parent_guth_gold_receipt_note: Extends benchmarks/guth-gold-physical-baseline-v1/physical_baseline.canonical.json (Guth-Gold reinforced-network, pooled LOIO R2=0.3345) by substituting two alternative published filler-reinforcement laws under identical split, bootstrap, and dataset.
shared_model_structure: H = H0*(1 + a*Vernetzung + b*HDI_IPDI)*R(phi); phi = cm*Mattierungsmittel + cp*Pigmentpaste; least_squares TRF, bounded, per LOIO training fold; deterministic.
